```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, results=TRUE, cache=FALSE}

require(knitr)
require(kableExtra)
require(DT)
require(rmdformats)
require(here)
require(quanteda)
require(quanteda.textstats)
source(here("scripts", "paths_and_packages.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = T)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = data_path)

#%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%#
#### Parameters ####
#%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%#

time_window_var <- 8
length_cl_var <- 2
share_cl_max_var <- 0.05
year_high <- 2014
year_low <- 1960
rationality_score_filter <- 0.05
rationality_prop_filter <- 0.10

#%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%#
#### Basic Corpus ####
#%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%#

# matching bd
matching <- readRDS(here(data_path, "final_match.RDS"))

# Similarity scores
rationality_score_original <- arrow::read_feather(here(data_path, "similarities_fulltexts_window_5.feather")) %>% as.data.table()
rationality_score_original[,id:=paste0("http://www.jstor.org/stable/", id)]
rationality_score <- rationality_score_original %>% rename(jstor_id = id, similarity = cosine_sim_centered) %>% select(jstor_id, similarity) %>% unique()
rationality_score <- merge(matching, rationality_score, all.x = TRUE, by.x = "id_jstor", by.y = "jstor_id")
rationality_score <- rationality_score[!is.na(id_match_final) & !is.na(similarity),.(id_match_final, similarity)] %>% rename(ID_Art = id_match_final)
rationality_score[,ID_Art:=as.character(ID_Art)]
rationality_score[,similarity:=mean(similarity), ID_Art]
rationality_score <- unique(rationality_score)
filter_mean_score_ids <- rationality_score %>% slice_max(similarity, prop = rationality_prop_filter) %>% .[[1]]

rationality_score_abstract <- arrow::read_feather(here(data_path, "similarities_wos_abstracts_window_5.feather")) %>% as.data.table()
ids_rationality_abstract <- rationality_score_abstract %>% slice_max(cosine_sim_centered, prop = rationality_prop_filter) %>% .[[1]]

filter_mean_score_ids <- append(filter_mean_score_ids, ids_rationality_abstract)

# corpus
corpus <- arrow::read_parquet(here(general_data_path,"all_art.parquet"), arrow.unsafe_metadata = TRUE)

# journals
journals <- fread(here(general_data_path,"all_journals.csv"))

# authors
authors <- readRDS(here(general_data_path, "all_aut.RDS"))

# corpus new variables
corpus <- merge(corpus, authors[Ordre==1, .(Nom, ID_Art)], by = "ID_Art", all.x = TRUE)
corpus <- corpus[, name_short:=  gsub("-.*","",Nom)]
corpus$name_short <- toupper(corpus$name_short)
corpus <- corpus[,Label:=paste0(name_short,",",Annee_Bibliographique)]
corpus[, c("name_short"):=NULL]

corpus <- merge(corpus, journals[,.(Code_Revue, Revue)], by="Code_Revue", all.x = TRUE)

refs_info <- copy(corpus)

# refs
refs <- arrow::read_parquet(here(general_data_path,"all_ref.parquet"), arrow.unsafe_metadata = TRUE)

# Networks and alluv
tf_idf <- readRDS(here(data_path,"Networks", 
                       paste("tf_idf", year_low, year_high,time_window_var,"year_windows",rationality_prop_filter,"rationality_score.RDS", sep = "_")))
alluv_dt <- readRDS(here(data_path,"Networks", 
                         paste("alluv", year_low, year_high,time_window_var,"year_windows",rationality_prop_filter,"rationality_score.RDS", sep = "_")))
tbl_networks <- readRDS(here(data_path,"Networks", 
                             paste("networks", year_low, year_high,time_window_var,"year_windows",rationality_prop_filter,"rationality_score.RDS", sep = "_")))
names_ai <- readRDS(here(data_path,"Networks", 
                         paste("label_ai", year_low, year_high,time_window_var,"year_windows",rationality_prop_filter,"rationality_score.RDS", sep = "_")))
names_ai <- names_ai %>% rename(dynamic_cluster_leiden=id_col)
names_ai[, value_col := str_replace_all(value_col, "\\.", "")]
names_ai[, value_col := make.unique(value_col, sep = " ")]

# tf_idf_networks
tf_idf_networks <- networkflow::extract_tfidf(tbl_networks, "Titre", "dynamic_cluster_leiden", grouping_across_list = TRUE, clean_word_method = "lemmatize", nb_terms = 20)

# add ai names
tf_idf <- merge(tf_idf, names_ai, by = "dynamic_cluster_leiden", all.x = TRUE)
tf_idf[!is.na(value_col), dynamic_cluster_leiden:=value_col]

alluv_dt <- merge(alluv_dt, names_ai, by = "dynamic_cluster_leiden", all.x = TRUE)
alluv_dt[!is.na(value_col), dynamic_cluster_leiden:=value_col]
alluv_dt[!is.na(Label), Label:=dynamic_cluster_leiden]

tf_idf_networks <- merge(tf_idf_networks, names_ai, by = "dynamic_cluster_leiden", all.x = TRUE)
tf_idf_networks[!is.na(value_col), dynamic_cluster_leiden:=value_col]

tbl_networks <- lapply(tbl_networks, function(tbl)(tbl %>% activate(nodes) %>% 
                                                     left_join(names_ai, by = "dynamic_cluster_leiden") %>%  
                                                     mutate(dynamic_cluster_leiden = ifelse(!is.na(value_col), value_col, dynamic_cluster_leiden))))
# similarity scores to network
tbl_networks <- lapply(tbl_networks, function(tbl)(tbl %>% activate(nodes) %>% 
                                                     left_join(rationality_score, by = "ID_Art")))

#%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%#
#### Variables and filtering ####
#%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%#

# Filtering
corpus <- corpus[Annee_Bibliographique>=year_low & Annee_Bibliographique<=year_high]
corpus <- corpus[ID_Art %in% filter_mean_score_ids]

refs <- refs[ID_Art %in% corpus$ID_Art]

refs <- refs[, name_short:=  gsub("-.*","",Nom)]
refs$name_short <- toupper(refs$name_short)
refs <- refs[,label_refs:=paste0(name_short,",",Annee)]
refs[, c("name_short"):=NULL]

refs_item0 <- refs[ItemID_Ref==0]
refs <- refs[ItemID_Ref!=0]
refs[,nb_cit_tot:=.N,ItemID_Ref]
refs <- merge(refs, refs_info[,.(ItemID_Ref, Titre, Revue)], by = "ItemID_Ref", all.x = TRUE)

authors <- authors[ID_Art %in% corpus$ID_Art]
authors[, Nom:=tolower(Nom)]

```

# Alluvial

```{r echo=FALSE,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, results=TRUE, out.width='100%'}

alluv_dt <- alluv_dt %>% mutate(
  window_plot = paste0(window, "-", as.numeric(window) + time_window_var),
  window_plot = factor(window_plot, levels = paste0(sort(unique(as.numeric(window) )), "-", sort(unique(as.numeric(window) )) + time_window_var)))

alluv_dt$dynamic_cluster_leiden <- forcats::fct_reorder(alluv_dt$dynamic_cluster_leiden, alluv_dt$minimize_crossing_order, min, .desc = TRUE)

alluv_named <- ggplot(alluv_dt, aes(x = window_plot, y= y_alluv, stratum = dynamic_cluster_leiden, alluvium = ID_Art, fill = main_colors, label = dynamic_cluster_leiden)) +
  geom_stratum(alpha =1, size=1/10) +
  geom_flow() +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  ggtitle("") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white', color = NA), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(y = "Share") +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(stat = "stratum", size = 2, aes(label = Label)) 
ggsave(plot=alluv_named, here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("alluv_named.png")), width=32, height=18, units = "cm")

alluv_dt_minimal <- copy(alluv_dt)
alluv_dt_minimal <- alluv_dt_minimal[share_cluster_max<=4, main_colors:="grey"]
alluv_dt_minimal <- alluv_dt_minimal[main_colors=="grey", Label:=NA]

alluv_named_minimal <- ggplot(alluv_dt_minimal, aes(x = window_plot, y= y_alluv, stratum = dynamic_cluster_leiden, alluvium = ID_Art, fill = main_colors, label = dynamic_cluster_leiden)) +
  geom_stratum(alpha =1, size=1/10) +
  geom_flow() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white', color = NA)) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  ggtitle("") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white', color = NA), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(y = "Share") +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(stat = "stratum", size = 2, aes(label = Label)) 
ggsave(plot=alluv_named_minimal, here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("alluv_named_minimal.png")), width=30, height=21, units = "cm")

ggsave(plot=alluv_named_minimal, here("pictures", paste0("alluv_named_minimal.png")), width=30, height=21, units = "cm")
```

## Select a community {.tabset .tabset-dropdown}

```{r echo=FALSE,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, results=TRUE, out.width='100%'}
alluv_dt[,ID_Art:=as.numeric(ID_Art)]
alluv_dt_as_nodes <- merge(alluv_dt, corpus[,.(ID_Art, ItemID_Ref, Label, Annee_Bibliographique, Revue)], by="ID_Art", all.x = TRUE)
alluv_dt_as_nodes <- merge(alluv_dt_as_nodes, refs[,.N,.(ItemID_Ref, nb_cit_tot)], by="ItemID_Ref", all.x = TRUE)
alluv_dt_as_nodes <- alluv_dt_as_nodes %>% rename(Label = Label.x,
                                                  label_node = Label.y)

alluv_dt_as_nodes[is.na(nb_cit_tot), nb_cit_tot:=0]
alluv_dt_as_nodes[,nodes_n_time_com:=.N, .(ID_Art, dynamic_cluster_leiden)]
alluv_dt_as_nodes[,weighted_size:=nb_cit_tot*nodes_n_time_com]

com_to_inspect <- alluv_dt[,.N, dynamic_cluster_leiden][order(-N),dynamic_cluster_leiden]

```

```{r,results = "asis", eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
for (com in com_to_inspect) {
  alluv_com  <- alluv_dt_as_nodes[dynamic_cluster_leiden==com]
  
  most_influential_nodes_com <- alluv_com[order(-weighted_size)][,.N, .(ID_Art, weighted_size)][1:10]
  most_influential_nodes_com <- merge(most_influential_nodes_com, corpus[,.(ID_Art, Titre, Label)], by = "ID_Art", all.x = TRUE) %>% .[order(-weighted_size)]
  
  most_productive_journals <- alluv_com[,.N,Revue][order(-N)][1:10]
  
  n_nodes_com <- alluv_com[,.N]
  
  most_influential_refs_com <- merge(alluv_com[,.(ID_Art)], refs, by = "ID_Art")
  most_influential_refs_com[,n_cit_ref:=.N, ItemID_Ref][,share:=n_cit_ref/n_nodes_com*100]
  most_influential_refs_com <- unique(most_influential_refs_com[order(-share)][,.(label_refs, share)]) %>% top_n(10)
  
  most_influential_noidrefs_com <- merge(alluv_com[,.(ID_Art)], refs_item0, by = "ID_Art")
  most_influential_noidrefs_com[,n_cit_ref:=.N, label_refs][,share:=n_cit_ref/n_nodes_com*100]
  most_influential_noidrefs_com <- unique(most_influential_noidrefs_com[order(-share)][,.(label_refs, share)]) %>% top_n(10)
  
  most_influential_journal <- alluv_com[,.N, Revue]
  most_influential_journal <- most_influential_journal[,share:=N/sum(N)][order(-N)] %>% top_n(10)
  
  most_productive_authors <- merge(alluv_com[,.(ID_Art)], authors, by = "ID_Art")
  most_productive_authors <- most_productive_authors[,.N, Nom]
  most_productive_authors <- most_productive_authors[order(-N)][1:10]
  
  tf_idf_com_alluv <- tf_idf[dynamic_cluster_leiden==com]
  
  # extracting the first year and last year of the community
  window_min <- min(alluv_com$Annee_Bibliographique)
  window_max <- max(alluv_com$Annee_Bibliographique)
  
  ################ Beginning of the template ######################
  cat("###","Community:", com, "\n")
  cat(paste0("  \nThe community exists from ", window_min," to ", window_max,". \n"))
  cat("It's most distinctive words are: ",tf_idf_com_alluv$term)
  
  
  cat("The most influential nodes of the community:")
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(most_influential_nodes_com) %>% 
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options =     c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("The most productive journals:")
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(most_productive_journals) %>% 
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options =     c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("The most common refs:")
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(most_influential_refs_com) %>% 
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options =     c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("The most common refs (without ItemID_Ref):")
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(most_influential_noidrefs_com) %>% 
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options =     c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("The most cited journal:")
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(most_influential_journal) %>% 
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options =     c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("The most productive authors of the community:")
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(most_productive_authors) %>% 
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options =     c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("  \n")
}

```

```{r echo=FALSE,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, results=TRUE, out.width='100%'}
years <- 1990

label_com <- tbl_networks[[paste0(years)]] %N>% as.data.table()
label_com <- label_com[,mean_coord_x:=mean(x), dynamic_cluster_leiden]
label_com <- label_com[,mean_coord_y:=mean(y), dynamic_cluster_leiden]
label_com <- label_com[main_colors!="grey", head(.SD, 1), dynamic_cluster_leiden]

zoom_x_y <- tbl_networks[[paste0(years)]] %N>% as.data.table()
zoom_x <- quantile(zoom_x_y$x, c(0.001, 0.999))
zoom_y <- quantile(zoom_x_y$y, c(0.001, 0.999))


plot <- ggraph(tbl_networks[[paste0(years)]], "manual", x = x, y = y) +
  geom_edge_arc(aes(color = color_edges, width = weight), alpha = 0.2, strength =0.2) +
  geom_node_point(aes(fill = main_colors, size = similarity), pch=21) +
  scale_edge_width_continuous(range = c(0.2, 0.5)) +
  theme_graph() +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = label_com, aes(x = mean_coord_x, y = mean_coord_y, label = as.character(dynamic_cluster_leiden), fill = main_colors, size = 1)) +
  # geom_node_text(aes(label = nom, size = size^2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_edge_colour_identity() +
  labs(title = paste0(as.character(years),"-",as.character(years+time_window_var-1))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = zoom_x, ylim = zoom_y)
# ggsave("Networks/coup_2000.png", width=30, height=20, units = "cm")
ggsave(plot=plot, here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("Network_clean_", years ,".png")), width=16, height=9, units = "cm", scale = 4)
```

```{r results = "asis", eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
list_ggplot_com <- list()

list_ggplot_similarity <- list()
for (years in list_years) {
  label_com <- tbl_networks[[paste0(years)]] %N>% as.data.table()
  label_com <- label_com[,mean_coord_x:=mean(x), dynamic_cluster_leiden]
  label_com <- label_com[,mean_coord_y:=mean(y), dynamic_cluster_leiden]
  label_com <- label_com[main_colors!="grey", head(.SD, 1), dynamic_cluster_leiden]
  
  list_ggplot_similarity[[as.character(years)]] <- ggraph(tbl_networks[[paste0(years)]], "manual", x = x, y = y) +
    geom_node_point(aes(fill = similarity, size = similarity), pch=21) +
    scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis") +
    theme_graph() +
    labs(title = paste0(as.character(years),"-",as.character(years+time_window_var-1)))
  
}

for (years in list_years) {
  
  # Preparation
  tbl <- tbl_networks[[paste0(years)]]
  # plot_network_year <- list_ggplot[[paste0(years)]]
  # ggsave(plot=plot_network_year, here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("Network_new_publications_coupling_", years ,".png")), width=30, height=20, units = "cm")
  plot_comnetwork_year <- list_ggplot_com[[paste0(years)]]
  ggsave(plot=plot_comnetwork_year, here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("Network_new_publications_coupling_kcom_", years ,".png")), width=16, height=9, units = "cm", scale = 4)
  plot_similarity_network_year <- list_ggplot_similarity[[paste0(years)]]
  ggsave(plot=plot_similarity_network_year, here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("Network_new_publications_coupling_similarity_", years ,".png")), width=16, height=9, units = "cm", scale = 4)
  nodes <- tbl %>% activate(nodes) %>% as.data.table()
  
  # Get name of communities
  com_to_inspect <- nodes[,.N,dynamic_cluster_leiden][order(-N),dynamic_cluster_leiden]
  
  ####################### tf_idf
  # Relevant iddoc
  relevant_iddoc <- nodes[,ID_Art]
  
  # Create and process corpus
  corpus_processed <- corpus(nodes, text_field = "Titre", docid_field = "ID_Art") %>%
    tokens(remove_numbers = TRUE, remove_punct = TRUE, remove_symbols = TRUE) %>%
    tokens_tolower() %>%
    tokens_remove(c(stopwords("en", source = "snowball"), 
                    stopwords("en", source = "nltk"), 
                    stopwords("en", source = "stopwords-iso"))) %>%
    tokens_wordstem(language = "english") %>%
    tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2, concatenator = " ") %>%
    dfm()
  
  tfidf_grouped <- corpus_processed %>%
    dfm_group(groups = dynamic_cluster_leiden) %>%
    dfm_tfidf(scheme_tf = "count", scheme_df = "inverse")  # True TF-IDF
  
  # Get top terms by TF-IDF score
  tfidf_results <- tfidf_grouped %>%
    textstat_frequency(n = 20, force = TRUE, groups = dynamic_cluster_leiden) %>%
    merge(unique(nodes[, .(dynamic_cluster_leiden, main_colors)]), 
          by.x = "group", by.y = "dynamic_cluster_leiden", all.x = TRUE)
  
  # Create TF-IDF plot
  tfidf_results <- merge(tfidf_results, nodes[,.N,dynamic_cluster_leiden], by.x = "group", by.y = "dynamic_cluster_leiden", all.x = TRUE)
  
  tfidf_plot <- tfidf_results %>%
    arrange(N) %>% 
    group_by(group) %>%
    slice_max(frequency, n = 10) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = frequency, 
               y = reorder_within(feature, frequency, group), 
               fill = main_colors)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
    scale_y_reordered() +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "TF-IDF Score", y = NULL, title = "TF-IDF by Cluster")
  ggsave(plot=tfidf_plot, here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("tfidf_publications_coupling_", years ,".png")), width=32, height=64, units = "cm")
  
  ####################### tf_idf
  # plot heatmap
  tbl <- tbl %>% 
    activate(edges) %>%
    mutate(new_Id_com_to = .N()$dynamic_cluster_leiden[to], new_Id_com_from = .N()$dynamic_cluster_leiden[from])
  
  edges <- tbl %>% activate(edges) %>% as.data.table()
  
  edges[new_Id_com_from > new_Id_com_to, c("new_Id_com_to", "new_Id_com_from")] <- edges[new_Id_com_from > new_Id_com_to, c("new_Id_com_from", "new_Id_com_to")] 
  
  id_nb_cit <- rbind(edges[,.(new_Id_com_from)],edges[,.(new_Id_com_to)],fill=TRUE)
  id_nb_cit <- id_nb_cit[is.na(new_Id_com_from),Label_com:=new_Id_com_to]
  id_nb_cit <- id_nb_cit[is.na(new_Id_com_to),Label_com:=new_Id_com_from]
  id_nb_cit <- id_nb_cit[,.N,Label_com]
  
  edges <- edges[,.N,.(new_Id_com_to,new_Id_com_from)]
  setnames(edges,"N", "n_occur")
  edges <-  merge(edges, id_nb_cit, by.x = "new_Id_com_to",by.y = "Label_com" )
  setnames(edges,"N", "nb_cit_Target")
  edges <-  merge(edges, id_nb_cit, by.x = "new_Id_com_from",by.y = "Label_com" )
  setnames(edges,"N", "nb_cit_Source")
  edges[,weight := n_occur/sqrt(nb_cit_Target*nb_cit_Source)] # cosine measure
  
  # edges <- complete(edges,new_Id_com_from, new_Id_com_to) %>% as.data.table()
  # edges <- edges[is.na(weight),weight:=0]
  edges <- edges[,weight:=round(weight,2)]
  
  mat <- tbl_graph(nodes = NULL, edges = edges[,.(new_Id_com_from,new_Id_com_to,weight)], directed = TRUE)
  mat <- as.matrix(as_adjacency_matrix(mat,attr = "weight"))
  mat[lower.tri(mat)] <- NA
  melted_cormat <- reshape2::melt(mat, diag = FALSE) %>% as.data.table()
  
  heat_map_plot <- ggplot(data = edges[new_Id_com_from!=new_Id_com_to], aes(x=new_Id_com_from, y=new_Id_com_to, fill=weight)) + 
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis(option = "viridis") +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_text(aes(label = weight), color = "white", size = 4)  +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))
  ggsave(plot=heat_map_plot, here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("heat_map_", years ,".png")), width=20, height=20, units = "cm")
  
  # Overview of network
  cat("##","Network ", years, "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("###","Plot of the network:", "\n")
  
  # cat("\n\n")
  # cat("![](", here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("Network_new_publications_coupling_", years ,".png")),")","\n")
  # cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("![](", here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("Network_new_publications_coupling_kcom_", years ,".png")),")","\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("###","Tfi-idf of all clusters:", "\n")
  
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("![](", here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("tfidf_publications_coupling_", years ,".png")),")","\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("###","Relationship between clusters:", "\n")
  
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("![](", here(data_path,"Pictures", paste0("heat_map_", years ,".png")),")","\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("###","Share of all clusters", "\n")
  
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(nodes[,.N,dynamic_cluster_leiden][, .(dynamic_cluster_leiden,share=N/nodes[,.N])][order(-share)][,.(dynamic_cluster_leiden,share=paste0(round(share,2)*100,"%"))]) %>% 
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options =     c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("###","Importance of rationality", "\n")
  
  cat("\n\n")
  print(kable(nodes[,mean(similarity), dynamic_cluster_leiden][order(-V1)] %>% mutate(V1=round(V1-nodes[,mean(similarity)],4))) %>% 
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options =     c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("\n\n")
  cat("###","Select a cluster to analyze {.tabset .tabset-dropdown}", "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  
  for (com in com_to_inspect) {
    ####################### Preparing the data to put in the template
    
    # restricting alluv_dt to the community at stake
    nodes_com  <- nodes[dynamic_cluster_leiden %in% paste0(com)]
    
    relevant_idart <- nodes_com[,ID_Art]
    
    n_doc_com <- length(unique(relevant_idart))
    
    most_cited_nodes <- nodes_com[order(-size),.(ID_Art, Titre, Revue, Label, size)]
    most_productive_journals <- nodes_com[,.N ,Revue][order(-N)]
    most_productive_authors <- authors[ID_Art %in% relevant_idart, .N ,Nom][order(-N)] %>% mutate(share=round(N/n_doc_com*100))
    
    most_cited_refs <- refs[ID_Art %in% relevant_idart & ItemID_Ref!=0, .N, .(ItemID_Ref, label_refs)][order(-N)]
    most_cited_refs <- merge(most_cited_refs, refs_info[,.SD[1], ItemID_Ref][,.(ItemID_Ref, Annee_Bibliographique, Revue, Titre)], by = "ItemID_Ref", all.x = TRUE)
    
    most_cited_refs_noids <- refs_item0[ID_Art %in% relevant_idart, .N, .(Nom, Annee, Revue_Abbrege)][order(-N)]
    
    most_cited_journal <- refs[ID_Art %in% relevant_idart & ItemID_Ref!=0, .N, Revue][order(-N)]
    
    
    ################ Beginning of the template ######################
    cat("####","Community:", com, "\n")
    
    cat("#####","Tables{.tabset}", "\n")
    cat("######","Biggest nodes of the community:")
    cat("\n\n")
    print(kable(most_cited_nodes[1:30]) %>% 
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("######","Most productive journals:")
    cat("\n\n")
    print(kable(most_productive_journals[1:20]) %>% 
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    cat("\n\n")
    
    
    cat("######","Most cited art:")
    cat("\n\n")
    print(kable(most_cited_nodes[1:20]) %>% 
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("######","Most productive authors:")
    cat("\n\n")
    print(kable(most_productive_authors[1:10]) %>% 
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # cat("######","Most productive institutions:")
    # cat("\n\n")
    # print(kable(most_productive_institutions[1:10]) %>%
    #         kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    # cat("\n\n")
    
    # cat("######","Most productive cities:")
    # cat("\n\n")
    # print(kable(most_productive_cities[1:10]) %>%
    #         kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    # cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("######","Most cited references:")
    cat("\n\n")
    print(kable(most_cited_refs[order(-N), .SD, .SDcols = !c('ItemID_Ref')][1:30]) %>% 
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("######","Most cited references (no ids):")
    cat("\n\n")
    print(kable(most_cited_refs_noids[order(-N)][1:30]) %>% 
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    cat("\n\n")
    
    cat("######","Most cited journal:")
    cat("\n\n")
    print(kable(most_cited_journal[order(-N)][1:30]) %>% 
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # cat("######","Most cited journal:")
    # cat("\n\n")
    # print(kable(most_cited_discipline[order(-N)][1:30]) %>% 
    #         kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", full_width = F)))
    # cat("\n\n")
    
    
    cat("\n")
    
    
    
  }}
```
